title: Kidnapper Realizes Cops Found His Victim in a Box
description:
In today's body camera video and true crime documentary, we're covering the case of Nicholas Cargain.

We are a news agency dedicated to delivering factual reporting on criminal investigations, public safety, and law enforcement procedures.
